answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents are assigned a unique digital identity, similar to a bridge connecting them to the network. Each agent is required to stake a certain amount of cryptocurrency, denoted as opal, which is used to deter malicious behavior. If an agent is found to be misbehaving or creating fake identities, its staked opal is converted to basalt, a valueless token, effectively penalizing the attacker and preventing further malicious activity at a significant cost.
